name: Cauliflower Rice Italian Sausage Casserole
ingredients: one 19.5 oz. pkg. uncooked Italian Sausage
salt and fresh-ground black pepper to taste
why: Strong pick: published 506 cal / 8.5g carbs / 29g protein lands mid-band with catalog-ideal protein. Italian sausage baked with cauliflower rice, mushrooms, pepper and mozzarella is a weigh-and-divide bake that scales to 14. Cauliflower-rice base keeps carbs very low; distinct from the rice-based turkey-sausage casserole already in catalog. All main ingredients map to the board.
